notablePrerequisites: Arcade Gannon does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Arcade Gannon by tapping it, causing you to loot and put a quest counter on it.
Tolarian Kraken and Nadir Kraken trigger.
Resolve the Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap Arcade Gannon.
Repeat.
